answer.summary: A medium ruined village near the founding stone: a half-collapsed great hall at the centre, four mossy cottages, a leaning watchtower on high ground, a roofless chapel, a cold smithy, a fallen barn at the edge and a broken gatehouse at the entrance. The weathered, vine-covered look comes from the style bible, written next; some buildings stay usable as a home base.
